products.title: Clinique  Moisture Surge 100H Auto-Replenishing Hydrator 75ml
products.body_html:
Clinique Moisture Surge 100H Auto-Replenishing Hydrator 75ml is a refreshing oil-free gel-cream moisturiser designed to deliver deep, lasting hydration. Powered by hyaluronic acid, aloe bio-ferment and activated aloe water, the lightweight formula works to support the skin’s moisture barrier and helps it hold onto water for longer. Skin is left feeling comfortably hydrated, soft and supple, with a plump, dewy look that sits beautifully under make-up. The cooling gel texture absorbs quickly without greasiness, making it an easy addition to any routine, morning or night.

Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive, this hydrator is fragrance free, alcohol free and dermatologist tested. It may help skin that feels tight, dull or dehydrated to appear smoother and more radiant. Use it as your everyday moisturiser after cleansing and serum, or apply a thicker layer as a quick 5-minute moisture mask. It can also be tapped lightly over make-up during the day whenever skin needs a comforting, hydrated boost.

Why we love it
- Lightweight, oil-free gel-cream texture that absorbs quickly and leaves skin feeling fresh, not greasy
- Powered by hyaluronic acid and aloe bio-ferment to help support long-lasting hydration and a plumper, dewy look
- Fragrance free, alcohol free and dermatologist tested, making it a comfortable choice for all skin types, including sensitive
- Versatile formula that fits easily into any routine, working as a daily moisturiser, a 5-minute moisture mask or a dewy top-up over make-up

How to use
How to Use:
After cleansing, pat the skin dry. Smooth a small amount of Clinique Moisture Surge 100H Auto-Replenishing Hydrator over the face and neck in light upward strokes. Use morning and evening as your moisturiser, or apply a thicker layer for 5 minutes as a quick moisture mask, then gently tissue off any excess. Tap a little over make-up during the day whenever skin feels dry for a fresh, dewy finish.

Frequency:
Use morning and night on clean skin, and as needed during the day according to the product instructions.

Application Technique:
Apply to clean, dry skin after serum or treatment. Use fingertips to spread the gel-cream evenly over the face and neck, avoiding direct contact with the eyes. Allow the formula to absorb fully before applying SPF in the daytime or make-up.

Best Practices:
Apply to freshly cleansed skin for best absorption. Use a thin, even layer for daily moisture and a more generous layer when using as a mask. Always follow with a broad-spectrum SPF in the morning. Store the jar closed and away from direct heat or sunlight.

Safety Tips:
For external use only. Avoid direct contact with eyes; if contact occurs, rinse well with water. Discontinue use if irritation occurs and seek advice if needed. Keep out of reach of children and always follow the directions on the packaging.

products.title: Clinique Even Better Makeup SPF15
products.body_html:
Clinique Even Better Makeup SPF15 in shade WN 56 Cashew is a liquid foundation designed to even the look of skin tone while feeling comfortable enough for everyday wear. Formulated with vitamin C and SPF 15, it helps to soften the appearance of dark spots and discolouration over time while supporting protection against future sun-induced marks. The creamy texture blends easily to a natural, skin-like finish with moderate coverage that smooths the look of pores and fine texture without feeling heavy or mask-like.

Ideal for dry combination to combination oily complexions, this foundation works well as the complexion step after skincare. Apply over moisturiser in the morning to create a more unified, brighter-looking base that lasts throughout the day. Stay-true pigments are designed to resist caking, streaking and colour change, even in humidity, so the shade remains flattering from application to evening. The result is skin that looks more even, comfortably hydrated and softly radiant, with the added reassurance of daily SPF protection.

Why we love it
- Natural-looking, moderate coverage helps to even tone while still letting skin look like skin.
- Vitamin C and SPF 15 work together to support a brighter-looking complexion and help defend against future discolouration.
- Lightweight, creamy texture feels comfortable on dry combination and combination oily skin, with stay-true pigments that resist caking and streaking.
- Long-wearing formula is designed to withstand humidity and daily life, making it an easy, reliable base for everyday make-up.

How to use
How to Use:
Apply after your usual skincare. Dispense a small amount of foundation and dot it onto the centre of the face, then blend outward over the cheeks, forehead, nose and chin. Build thin layers where extra coverage is desired. Remove thoroughly with a suitable make-up remover at the end of the day.

Frequency:
Use as needed, typically as part of a daily make-up routine.

Application Technique:
Use clean fingertips, a foundation brush or a damp sponge to smooth and blend the formula over the skin, taking care to diffuse edges along the jawline and hairline for a seamless finish.

Best Practices:
Apply to clean, well-moisturised skin and allow skincare to absorb before foundation. Start with a small amount and build gradually to avoid a heavy look. Pair with additional SPF if spending extended time outdoors, and set with powder if extra longevity or shine control is desired.

Safety Tips:
For external use only. Avoid direct contact with eyes; if contact occurs, rinse well with water. Discontinue use if irritation occurs and keep out of reach of children. Always follow any additional guidance on the product packaging.

products.body_html:
Clinique Happy For Men Cologne Eau de Toilette Spray is a cool, uplifting fragrance designed to bring an easy sense of confidence to everyday life. The scent opens with a bright hit of citrus, blending Kaffir lime, kalamanzi fruit, mandarin and yuzu for a crisp, energetic start. A touch of green notes adds freshness, while a base of cedar, Mediterranean cypress and guaiacwood gives a smooth, woody character that feels quietly masculine and modern. It works particularly well as a daytime fragrance, adding a fresh finishing touch after a morning shower or shave. Spritz onto pulse points such as the neck and wrists to enjoy a scent that feels refreshing, polished and easy to wear, whether you’re heading to the office, meeting friends or travelling.

Why we love it
- Bright citrus notes of Kaffir lime, mandarin and yuzu help to create a fresh, energising start to the day
- Green and marine nuances keep the fragrance feeling clean, modern and easy to wear in warmer weather

Apply to clean, dry skin. Hold the bottle a few inches away from the body. Spray Clinique Happy For Men Cologne Eau de Toilette onto pulse points such as the neck, wrists and chest. Allow the fragrance to settle before dressing. Reapply as desired throughout the day.

Frequency:
Use as needed, according to the product instructions.

Application Technique:

Best Practices:

Safety Tips:
For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes and irritated skin. If irritation occurs, discontinue use. Keep out of reach of children and always follow the directions on the packaging.

Clinique Liquid Facial Soap Extra-Mild for Very Dry to Dry Skin is a dermatologist-developed liquid cleanser designed to care for delicate, moisture-poor skin. The creamy, soap-free formula works to lift away daily impurities, pollution and excess oil while helping to respect the skin’s natural moisture barrier. Fragrance-free and allergy tested, it’s a reassuring choice if skin is easily upset by harsher foaming washes.

Ideal for very dry to dry complexions, this cleanser fits seamlessly into a simple, twice-daily skincare routine. Use it as the first step after makeup removal to prepare the skin for toner and moisturiser, helping subsequent products absorb more evenly. The gentle texture makes it suitable for everyday use, morning and evening, whenever skin needs a thorough yet comforting cleanse that supports a calm, supple-looking finish.

Why we love it
- Extra-mild, fragrance-free formula that helps to cleanse very dry to dry skin without leaving it feeling tight or stripped.
- Enriched with conditioning ingredients such as glycerin, hyaluronic acid, sucrose and olive oil to support a softer, more comfortable complexion.
- Works as the first step in Clinique’s simple 3-step routine, preparing skin for clarifying lotion and moisturiser.
- Dermatologist-developed and allergy tested, making it a reassuring everyday choice for delicate or easily sensitised skin.

How to use
How to Use:
Begin with makeup-free skin. Dispense a small amount of the cleanser into your hands and add lukewarm water to create a light lather. Massage gently over the face and neck, avoiding the eye area. Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water and pat the skin dry with a clean towel. Follow with your chosen clarifying lotion and moisturiser.

Frequency:
Use twice daily, morning and evening, or according to the product instructions.

Application Technique:
Apply with clean hands using gentle, circular motions, taking care around drier areas of the face. Rinse until no residue remains, then immediately follow with the next steps in your skincare routine.

Best Practices:
Use on damp skin rather than very hot or very cold water to help minimise dryness. Pair with a hydrating toner and moisturiser to support the skin’s moisture barrier. If skin is particularly dry, start with once-daily use and build up as comfortable.

Safety Tips:
For external use only. Avoid direct contact with the eyes; if contact occurs, rinse well with water. Discontinue use if irritation occurs and consult the product packaging for any additional guidance. Keep out of reach of children.

How to use

Frequency:

Best Practices:

products.title: Clinique  Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum 50ml
products.body_html:
Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum 50ml is a targeted anti-ageing serum designed to soften the look of lines and wrinkles while supporting a smoother, more radiant complexion. The lightweight, silky texture layers comfortably under moisturiser and is suitable for all skin types, including sensitive. Powered by Clinique’s CL1870 Peptide Complex, a blend of peptides that helps to support skin’s firmness, the formula also includes a gentle retinoid to refine texture and hyaluronic acid to provide lasting hydration and a plumped appearance. With regular use, skin may look more even, feel more resilient and appear more youthful.

This serum fits easily into a daily skincare routine as the treatment step after cleansing and before moisturising. It’s designed to address fine lines around the eyes and lips, as well as more visible expression lines on the forehead and around the mouth, making it a versatile choice for those starting to notice signs of ageing or looking to refine more established wrinkles. Used consistently alongside a nourishing cream and daily SPF, it helps to promote smoother, comfortable, well-cared-for skin.

Why we love it
- Harnesses a high level of peptides plus a gentle retinoid to help soften the look of fine lines and deeper wrinkles.
- Lightweight, silky serum texture sinks in quickly, making it easy to layer under any moisturiser or SPF.
- Hyaluronic acid helps to hydrate and plump, leaving skin feeling smoother and more comfortable.
- Suitable for all skin types and fragrance free, so it’s a considered choice for those with sensitivity who still want targeted anti-ageing care.

How to use
How to Use:
Apply to clean, dry skin. Dispense 1–2 pumps of Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum onto fingertips, then smooth evenly over the face and neck, avoiding the eye area. Allow the serum to absorb fully before following with moisturiser and eye cream.

Frequency:
Use twice daily, morning and evening, as part of a regular skincare routine.

Application Technique:
Work with light, upward strokes, paying particular attention to areas where lines and wrinkles are more visible, such as the forehead, around the mouth and along smile lines. Layer a hydrating cream over the top and finish with SPF in the morning.

Best Practices:
Apply after cleansing and any toner, but before moisturiser. Use a small amount to create a thin, even layer rather than over-applying. Allow a few moments for the serum to settle before adding the next step in your routine. Always follow with a broad-spectrum SPF during the day when using retinoid-based skincare.

Safety Tips:
For external use only. Avoid direct contact with eyes; if contact occurs, rinse well with water. If irritation occurs, reduce frequency or discontinue use. Do not use at the same time as other retinol or retinoid products. Keep out of reach of children and follow any additional guidance on the packaging.
